title: feat(post): a Sodick LN2W wire post and a Sodick AQ600L machine file
body:
## What changed

- A new post script, `assets/posts/sodick-ln2w.cps`, is in the registry as **Sodick Wire EDM (LN2W)**.
- It is a second `.cps` file beside the Mark 21 script. The post engine evaluates one script text and has no include, so the two scripts cannot share code. A dialect option in `sodick-wire.cps` was not used, because `controller.post` of a machine file names a registry entry and cannot set an option.
- `assets/posts/sodick-wire.cps` has no change. The Mark 21 output is byte-identical.
- Each cut starts in the order that the owner of the AQ600L gave after his round-2 dry run (PR comment of 2026-11-25): `G00 X Y U0. V0.` on one line, `Z0.`, `T91`, `T84`, `T94`, the `C` word, then the first `G01`. There is no separate `U0. V0.` line.
- The post writes no `G20` and no `G21`. It declares `programUnits = "mm"`, so the engine refuses an inch document by name.
- The post writes vertical 2-axis cuts only. It refuses each taper by name: a `WireTaper` section, an angle word, a U V lean. A taper (`TP` / `TN`, `G51` / `G52` `A`, `G50`) waits for #4075. See "Round 3" below.
- A skim pass takes `T85` (`edm.skim_flushing`) and its own `C` word.
- A new machine file, `assets/machines/sodick-aq600l.mch` (**Sodick AQ600L**), names the LN2W post as its default post. U/V travel is 80 x 80 mm. It states no `edm.taper_angle`.
- The three EDM test parts (`mkinney/cam-tools-and-fixtures`, `samples/edm-validation`, commit `c687f53f9`) are in `testdata/models/edm/`. The kernel STEP bench (`step_agreement`) pins them.
- The header line `NOT VERIFIED ON A CONTROL` stays.
- The guides and `assets/posts/AGENTS.md` describe the new post.
- The decision record is `docs/decisions/4045-sodick-ln2w-dialect.md`.

### Round 3 (review of head `b12db2f06`, and the owner's correction)

| Finding | What changed |
|---|---|
| 1. U/V travel 120 mm | U/V is 80 x 80 mm (+-40), from the brochure that the review cites. The example guide span is 100 mm: a 20 degree lean is 36.4 mm, inside the 40 mm half travel. The profile test checks both. |
| 2. `mitre` corners with no evidence | The file states no `edm.taper_angle`. The post refuses each tapered cut, so no cut depends on a corner rule. |
| 3. `top_right` leans to the wrong side | No `G51` / `G52` is written. A taper on a `top_right` machine, with a positive or a negative angle, is refused by name. A regression case pins it. |
| 4. One fixture height for each setup | `edm.table_to_part_bottom` and `PARAM WireBottom` are removed (they were this PR's own). No `TP` / `TN` is written. The taper waits for a setup height (#4075). |
| 5. STEP bench skips `edm/` | `step_agreement` reads `testdata/models/edm/`, has three rows and three tests. A new STEP subdirectory that no bench pins fails the file-set test. `edge_gap/` is named as the `step_edge_gap` bench's. |
| 6. 0.0004 degree posts as `A0.` | No `A` word is written. A 0.0004 degree taper is refused by name. A regression case pins it. |
| Optional: pin path in `assets/posts/AGENTS.md` | It names `crates/post/tests/sodick_ln2w/pins.rs` and the binary `script_sodick_ln2w`. |
| Owner: `U0. V0.` on the rapid | `startCut` writes `G00 X Y U0. V0.`. The header comment and the guide state the new order. |

### Each hunk in an existing file

| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `crates/app/src/posting.rs`, `posting_files.rs` | Register the post and the machine file. |
| `crates/app/tests/conformance.rs`, `machine.rs`, `crates/post/tests/comment_escape.rs` | List tests that the new post and the new machine must join. |
| `crates/app/tests/wire_post.rs` | Declares the new submodule of the suite. |
| `crates/kernel/tests/step_agreement.rs`, `step_agreement/rows.rs` | Read `edm/`, add its three rows and tests, and refuse a STEP subdirectory that no bench pins. |

`crates/post/src/machine/*`, `crates/post/src/post/machine.rs`, `crates/app/src/posting_wire*.rs`, `docs/CNC-INTERMEDIATE.md` and `assets/machines/AGENTS.md` are back to `main`: no diff.

## Cause

The Sodick post writes the Mark 21 word set. The LN2W control of the AQ600L alarms on `G21` (`E00170`) and needs a different start order.

## Sources

- The statements of the owner of a Sodick AQ600L (LN2W), relayed on #4045, #1500 and this PR.
- The Sodick LN1W / LN2W operation manual (2012), as this repository already records it (#4045, #1500, the decisions #1496, #1497, #2649, #2686). This session could not open the PDF: the web request was blocked.
- Sodick AQ400L / AQ600L brochure, page 7, as the review cites it. This session could not open it.
- No other CAM product's post or output was read.

## Tests

Pins:

- `crates/post/tests/sodick_ln2w/pins.rs` (in the `script_sodick_ln2w` binary), 5 tests on synthetic streams: `the_start_sequence_is_the_owners_and_no_unit_word_is_written`, `every_taper_is_refused_by_name_and_writes_no_taper_word` (findings 3, 4, 6), `a_lean_without_a_taper_section_is_refused_by_name`, `a_skim_pass_takes_the_low_flushing_word_and_its_own_condition`, `a_control_side_wire_offset_is_refused_by_name`.
- `crates/app/tests/wire_post/sodick_aq600l.rs` (in the `wire_post` binary), 6 tests: `the_aq600l_file_states_its_figures_and_names_the_ln2w_post` (findings 1, 2), the library entry, the two goldens in the owner's order, `the_ln2w_taper_part_is_refused_by_name_until_its_heights_and_rules_are_confirmed`, and the Mark 21 words on the same machine.
- `step_agreement`: `step_edm_test_2axis`, `step_edm_test_square`, `step_edm_test_taper`, `step_files_agree_or_refuse_by_name` (finding 5).
- `script_sodick_ln2w`: the 11 recorded streams of the per-script suite, each a named refusal (no change).

The pins fail without the change: on `upstream/main` the registry has no LN2W post and no AQ600L.

Mutation results on `5bd7ff4dd` (each mutation applied, the pins run, the file restored; 8 of 8 red, all green after the restore):

| Mutation | Red pin |
|---|---|
| `U0. V0.` back on a line of its own | `the_start_sequence_is_the_owners_and_no_unit_word_is_written`, `the_ln2w_square_posts_its_golden_in_the_owners_start_order`, `the_ln2w_two_axis_block_posts_its_golden` |
| No `U0. V0.` on the `G00` | the same tests |
| The taper refusal removed from `onSection` | `every_taper_is_refused_by_name_and_writes_no_taper_word`, `a_lean_without_a_taper_section_is_refused_by_name` |
| An angle word accepted in `cutOk` | `a_lean_without_a_taper_section_is_refused_by_name` |
| U travel back to +-60 mm | `the_aq600l_file_states_its_figures_and_names_the_ln2w_post` |
| Guide span 130 mm (a 20 degree lean is past 40 mm) | the same test |
| A `mitre` `edm.taper_angle` back in the file | the same test |
| The bench skips `edm/` | `step_files_agree_or_refuse_by_name` |

Commands on the final head `5bd7ff4dd` (`upstream/main` `034e91b8b` merges with it cleanly; it is not merged in, because there is no conflict):

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 868 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, 60.2 min. It includes `kernel suites: step_agreement`, `post suites: script_sodick_ln2w`, `post suites: script_sodick_wire`, `app suites: wire_post`, `sodick_wire_post`, `conformance`, `machine`, `example_catalog` (ok), `example_catalog_adaptive` (ok), `example_catalog_edge_work` (ok) and `ui suites: lib` (ok). No catalog program changed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-kernel --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo xtask gate light` and the heavy lanes did not run: this is a `P6`, and AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review" gives a `P6` PR no heavy step.

## Goldens moved

- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/sodick-ln2w/edm_test_square.nc` and `edm_test_2axis.nc`: `G00 X.. Y..` takes `U0. V0.`, and the separate `U0. V0.` line before the first cut is removed. This is the owner's correction. No other line moved.
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/sodick-ln2w/edm_test_taper.nc`: removed. The taper part is pinned as a refusal by name (#4075).
- `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/sodick-ln2w/*.refusal`: no change (the suite ran green with no rewrite).
- The Mark 21 goldens under `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/sodick-wire/` have no diff. `sodick-wire.cps` has no diff.

## Not exercised

- **No control ran this output.** The header says so.
- **The AQ600L figures are not checked by this session against a published source.** U/V 80 x 80 mm is the figure that the review cites from Sodick's brochure, page 7. This session could not open it. The thickness at which the 20 degree rating applies is not recorded.
- No taper is posted. #4075 holds the four conditions: a setup height for `TP` / `TN`, the confirmed corner motion, the lean side, and the angle precision.
- Wire offset by `G41` / `G42` with `H` registers is not written. A `COMP` record is refused by name (#1498).
- 4-axis cuts are refused by name (#2130 is open).
- No UI change, so there are no screenshots.
- The dry-run kit for the owner is not refreshed in this PR. It is in a different repository.
- The full heavy lanes did not run (AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review": no PR gets the full heavy lanes, and this is a `P6`).

## New top-level test file

`crates/post/tests/script_sodick_ln2w.rs` is a new test binary: each shipped script has its own `post_suite!` binary (#926). The other new tests are in existing suites.

## Overlaps

- #4040 and #4022 change `assets/posts/AGENTS.md`, `crates/app/tests/conformance.rs` and the two guide pages: different rows and lines.
- #3982 and #2646 change `crates/app/src/posting_files.rs` (and #2646 `conformance.rs`): different list rows.
- #3617 changes `assets/posts/AGENTS.md` and the Mark 21 tests: different lines.
- #4058 (main was red after #4002) was fixed on `main` by #4064, and this branch holds that merge.

Effort: high

Changelog: Sodick wire EDM: a new post "Sodick Wire EDM (LN2W)" (no G21, the owner's start order with U0. V0. on the start rapid, vertical 2-axis cuts; a taper is refused by name until #4075) and a new machine file "Sodick AQ600L"; the Mark 21 post has no change. Not verified on a control.

Fixes #4045
